query: SELECT dc.bookId, b.title, b.runId, COUNT(*) as winners_no_images FROM design_concepts dc JOIN books b ON dc.bookId = b.id WHERE dc.isWinner = 1 AND (dc.imageUrlA IS NULL OR dc.imageUrlA = 'NULL') GROUP BY dc.bookId, b.title, b.runId;
